iForgotMyPassword: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. If the address has an account, you will receive an email link. Use the most recent link. If you only use Mastodon sign-in, reset your password on your Mastodon server.
Use the recovery option in the MFA dialog or contact the operator. Recovery requires verification of account ownership. Never share passwords, one-time codes or recovery links in a public issue.
Why can't Mastodon find my Nolto address?

Check that federation is enabled in your profile settings and search for the full username@nolto.social address. WebFinger must be reachable on the Nolto domain. If discovery still fails, contact the operator with your address and the server you searched from.
Do my two accounts sync automatically?

No. Mastodon sign-in and account linking identify you. Linking does not merge followers, posts, passwords, bookmarks or private messages. Read the federation guide before importing follows or moving followers.
What do profile privacy choices mean?

Experience, education and skills follow their visibility settings. Hiding activity or articles on your profile does not unpublish content already public in feeds or at its own link. New private Nolto messages are end-to-end encrypted once both participants activate their inboxes. Older messages are labelled and may be readable by the server.
I forgot my inbox key phrase

Your account password and key phrase are separate. Unlock another device with the same phrase, or use your downloaded encrypted key backup together with the phrase. Nolto cannot recreate a lost key phrase. Never send the phrase or key backup to support.

The account or content is hidden immediately and permanent deletion is scheduled for 30 days after the request. Contact the operator if earlier erasure is needed. Copies already received by other servers may remain.
How do I report a problem?
Use Report where available or contact the operator below with a link and a short description. Deleting content on Nolto cannot guarantee that other servers or people delete their copies.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: The data Nolto uses, what federation shares, and your rights.
sections: Responsibility and contact

Jonatan Tensetti operates Nolto.social and is the data controller for personal data processed as part of this service. Contact the operator at the email address below about personal data or a data protection request. Other federated servers have independent operators who are responsible for their own processing of personal data and have their own policies.
Data and purposes

We process your account email and authentication data, the optional profile fields you supply, content and relationships to provide the features you use. We do not sell personal data. We do not track profile visits or store message previews in contact requests. Consent records and MFA recovery requests do not retain IP addresses or browser identifiers. Hosting providers may still process technical connection information. Security logs and moderation records are used to protect the service and handle reports.
Legal bases

Account management and requested features rely on performing our agreement with you. Security and moderation rely on a legitimate interest in operating a safe service, balanced against your privacy. Legal obligations may require additional processing. Where a feature requires consent, it must be requested separately and be withdrawable.
Public content and federation

Profiles and public posts can be read by others. Enabling federation allows profile data, images, posts, reactions and account relationships to be sent to other servers using ActivityPub. WebFinger makes username@nolto.social discoverable. Recipients may be outside the EU/EEA. Editing or deleting content in Nolto cannot guarantee that every recipient deletes its copy.
Bluesky sign-in

When Bluesky sign-in is available, you authorize it with your account provider. Nolto stores your persistent AT Protocol identity (DID) linked to your Nolto account. We request sign-in permission only and do not collect posts, follows or private messages. Temporary server-side sign-in state is encrypted, expires after ten minutes and is then cleared. Access tokens are not kept after sign-in. Nolto never receives your Bluesky password. Link an existing Nolto account in profile settings to avoid creating a separate account.
Language reminders and review

Text submitted for publication is checked against a limited set of Swedish and English rules in Nolto’s database. The preflight check does not store the draft or send it to an external analysis service. Personal attacks may receive a reminder you can override. Some explicit threats and calls for group violence are held for human review. Rules can miss content or misunderstand context and do not assess images. My reviews shows the status and lets you provide context or request reconsideration. Review notes are deleted when the associated content is permanently deleted. Private messages are excluded from these text checks.
Mastodon sign-in

When you choose Mastodon sign-in, Nolto contacts that server to identify your account. Nolto does not receive your Mastodon password. An authorization token may be stored encrypted on the server. Signing in does not merge accounts or synchronize all history and private messages.
Providers and security

The backend runs on Lovable Cloud using Supabase technology for database, authentication and files. Email may use Resend. Providers process information needed for operation. Other federated servers have independent operators. Public profiles, posts and files must be readable by the service and receiving servers. Encryption in transit and encryption using a server key are not end-to-end encryption and cannot eliminate the risk of a breach.
Private messages

New private messages between Nolto accounts are encrypted and signed in the browser. Both participants must activate their encrypted inbox. The key phrase is never sent to Nolto; the private key is backed up only in encrypted form. An unlocked key is held in browser memory and locked on sign-out, page exit or 15 minutes of inactivity. Sender, recipient and timestamps remain visible to the server. Older messages are labelled separately and can be decrypted by the server. Public content and messages on other services are excluded. Keep your key phrase and encrypted key backup safe: resetting your account password does not recover the key phrase. Compare key fingerprints through another trusted channel. An attacker controlling your device or the code delivered by the service may still access content while you use the inbox.
Retention and rights

Requesting deletion of an account, post, comment or article hides it immediately from Nolto’s ordinary interface and API. Account access is disabled at the same time. Permanent deletion is scheduled for 30 days after the request. During that period data is isolated from ordinary access; retained content is encrypted with a separate server key and a background job moves files to a private encrypted archive. This is not end-to-end encryption. If a post or article was reported before deletion, authorised moderators can review its archived text while the report is open and retention has not expired. Access is logged and does not extend retention. This process does not give moderators access to private messages. Authentication rate-limit logs are pruned after one day, federation logs after seven days and MFA recovery requests after 30 days. Limited identifiers may be kept as federation tombstones and to prevent takeover of a retired federation address. Provider backups and copies already downloaded by recipients follow separate processes. GDPR requests are assessed without undue delay and may require earlier erasure; the 30-day workflow does not restrict your rights. Contact us if urgent or broader erasure is needed.
Your rights

You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction and, where applicable, portability, object to legitimate-interest processing and withdraw consent. Contact us below; proportionate identity verification may be needed. You may complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection at imy.se.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Your account, your content and independent federated servers.
sections: Service operator
Nolto was created by Jonatan Tensetti, who also operates Nolto.social. These terms apply between you and the service operator. You can reach the operator at the email address under Contact.
Your account

Nolto is a professional network for people aged 16 and above. Protect your credentials and use two-factor authentication where possible. Do not impersonate others or represent an organization without authority. Contact us if your account may have been compromised.
Your content

You retain your rights to your content. You grant Nolto the non-exclusive permission to store, display and transmit it as needed for the features you use, including federation when enabled. You are responsible for having the right to publish it and respecting others' privacy and rights.
Federated identity

A Nolto address is a social identity, not an email address. Once published, it needs to remain stable. Mastodon and other services have separate accounts and rules. Following an account, importing follows or moving followers does not transfer or synchronize all data, history or private messages.
Moderation and review

Harassment, threats, hate, fraud, spam and illegal content are prohibited. Nolto may restrict content, accounts or federation in response to abuse. We aim for proportionate action and an understandable explanation where safety and legal duties permit. Report issues in the service or contact us. You may ask for a decision to be reviewed and explain why you disagree.
Availability, closure and changes

Maintenance and faults may interrupt the service. Verify user-provided job adverts and offers independently. These terms do not limit mandatory legal rights or promise specific uptime or compatibility with every server. You may stop using the service and request account deletion; remote copies may remain. Material changes should be communicated before taking effect where possible.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.intro: What your browser stores when you use Nolto.
sections: Message keys

The browser stores key fingerprints to detect key changes. The key phrase and unlocked private keys are not written to local storage. Clearing browser storage removes prior comparisons; verify fingerprints again afterwards.
Sessions

The Supabase client stores session credentials in localStorage to keep you signed in. They are used to authenticate requests to the service, rather than remaining exclusively on your device. Sign out on shared devices.
Preferences and temporary data

Nolto stores language, theme and some interface preferences locally. Mastodon and Bluesky sign-in use sessionStorage to bind the callback to your sign-in attempt. A referral code may be retained with a 24-hour expiry. Clearing site data may require signing in and selecting preferences again.
Other services

The application code does not include advertising tracking or Google Analytics. Hosting and security providers may use technical storage depending on the deployment. External images and links may contact other services with their own policies. Consent must be obtained before enabling any storage that requires it.

conduct.title: Code of conduct
conduct.intro: Space to collaborate and disagree without harassment.
sections: Treat people respectfully
Challenge ideas and decisions. Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, make unwanted sexual advances or organize attacks. Respect a request to stop contacting someone.
Be clear and honest
Do not impersonate others. Make commercial offers and recruitment intentions clear. Avoid mass messaging, misleading advertisements, fabricated qualifications and automated manipulation.
Respect privacy and rights
Do not publish private contact details, conversations or sensitive personal information without a right to do so. Respect copyright and cite sources where they help others assess a claim.
Report and appeal

Use the report feature or contact us with a link and short description. You may request an explanation and review of action affecting you. Remote servers have their own moderators; Nolto can restrict federation but cannot control their content.

instances.title: Instance guidelines
instances.intro: Responsibilities for operators of independent installations.
sections: Independent operation

An installation needs an identified operator, a contact channel, its own terms and a data protection assessment. Using Nolto's code does not make Nolto.social responsible for your installation or guarantee its security. Follow the repository license.
Stable identity

Choose the federation domain before publishing accounts. WebFinger, actor documents, key identifiers and signatures must use consistent permanent identities. Redirecting the website alone does not preserve federation.
Operation and compatibility

Maintain updates, access controls, signing keys, backups, recovery tests and delivery monitoring. Establish abuse and incident procedures. Test discovery, follows, publishing, editing and deletion against a separate server before opening. ActivityPub and AT Protocol are distinct; describe the interoperability actually available.
